Comprehensive audit of Rankora at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora` against the competitor feature catalog. For EVERY feature listed below, check if it EXISTS, is PARTIAL, or MISSING. Be fast — just grep/check files, don't read full contents.

## Section 2: Core ATS (ADD features)
1. Job posting + careers page — check CareerPage.tsx, CareerSettings.tsx
2. Custom application form builder — check FormBuilder.tsx
3. Drag-and-drop kanban pipeline — check KanbanBoard.tsx
4. Resume parsing (bulk) — check BulkUploadZone.tsx, parse-resume function
5. Candidate profile unified view — check CandidateDetailSheet.tsx
6. Custom pipeline stages per role — check usePipelineStages, PipelineStageManager
7. Email + calendar sync — search "gmail", "outlook", "calendar sync", "oauth"
8. Collaborative scorecards + notes — check ScorecardPanel, CandidateNotesPanel
9. Team roles + permissions — check useTeam, team_members table
10. Mobile-responsive — check use-mobile.tsx
11. Basic reporting dashboard — search "analytics", "reporting", "time-to-hire", "funnel"
12. CSV import/export — check CSVImportDialog, csvExport
13. Auto-acknowledgement emails — check AutoAckSettings

## Section 3: Differentiators (MOAT + ADD)
14. Flat-fee pricing — check LandingPage pricing section
15. AI candidate ranking — check rank-resumes function
16. AI candidate summary cards — check CandidateSummaryCard
17. Fake/AI resume detector — search "authenticity", "fake", "audit", "ai-detect"
18. WhatsApp messaging — check WhatsApp components
19. AI JD generator — check JDGeneratorDialog, generate-jd function
20. AI rejection emails — check RejectCandidateDialog or RejectWithFeedbackDialog
21. Knockout questions — check FormBuilder is_knockout
22. Stage-triggered automation — search "automation", "stage action", "trigger on stage"
23. Self-serve interview scheduling — check ScheduleInterviewDialog, BookInterview
24. LinkedIn Chrome extension — search manifest.json, chrome extension files
25. Incognito/bias-blind mode — search "incognito", "bias", "blind", "anonymize"
26. Talent pool + candidate rediscovery — search "talent pool", "rediscovery", "re-rank"
27. Open API + Zapier — check ApiDocs, api_keys, public-api function
28. Sub-10-minute setup — check OnboardingWizard or onboarding flow

## Section 4: Agency features (MOAT + ADD)
29. White-label branding — check career page custom CSS, logo, colors
30. Custom domain hosting — search "custom domain", "CNAME"
31. Client portal — check SharedPortal, GuestLinkDialog
32. Client approval workflow — search "approval", "client feedback"
33. CV reformatting/agency template — search "reformat", "cv template", "strip contact"
34. Multi-client/multi-job-order — search "client", "job order", "multi-client"
35. Placement tracking — search "placement", "start date", "probation"
36. Commission calculator — search "commission", "fee"
37. Lightweight client CRM — search "crm", "deals", "pipeline" (client-side, not candidate)
38. Invoicing/billing — search "invoice", "billing" (for clients, not Rankora billing)

## Section 5: AI-native (MOAT + ADD)
39. JD-to-candidate semantic ranking — already have (rank-resumes)
40. AI JD generator — already checked
41. AI candidate summary — already checked
42. AI interview question generator — check if results have interview_questions
43. AI resume authenticity scoring — search "authenticity", "fake cv"
44. AI email drafting — check EmailOutreachDialog for AI drafting
45. AI-powered search — search "natural language search", "ai search", "semantic search"

## Section 6: Integrations
46. Gmail + Outlook sync — already checked
47. Google Cal + Outlook Cal — already checked
48. LinkedIn Chrome extension — already checked
49. Indeed Apply — check indeed-feed function
50. Google Jobs — check JSON-LD in CareerPage
51. Zapier — search "zapier"
52. WhatsApp Business API — already checked
53. Slack — search "slack"

Report as a table: # | Feature | Status (BUILT/PARTIAL/MISSING) | Key evidence
